description: Source code for extracting and parsing Certificate Transparency (CT) related objects, including SCT lists from certificates and OCSP responses, with functions for handling ASN.1 structures and extensions.

methods.name: ExtractEmbeddedSCTList
methods.description: Extracts the embedded SCT list from a certificate's ASN.1 structure.

methods.name: GetPrecertSignedEntry
methods.description: Generates a precertificate signed entry from leaf and issuer certificates.

methods.name: GetX509SignedEntry
methods.description: Creates an X.509 signed entry from a leaf certificate.

methods.name: ExtractSCTListFromOCSPResponse
methods.description: Extracts SCT list from an OCSP response matching a specific certificate.
